thread:
Maria: Quick heads-up — PR #8429 (adaptive-alloc) is sitting in canary and I see a small p95 tail bump for 4k sequences. Would appreciate 2 quick eyes. Bench artifacts: https://bench.internal/runs/8429 :wave:

Chris: Looking now. Quick paste of the summary numbers from the canary run: 
```
baseline (main):
  p50: 12ms  p95: 85ms  p99: 210ms  mem: 9.8GB
canary (pr/8429):
  p50: 12ms  p95: 98ms  p99: 220ms  mem: 10.6GB
delta: +13ms p95, +0.8GB mem
```

Sam: Hmm, +0.8GB is notable but not huge. Is this constant or only at tail? Any difference in batch mix?

Maria: Looks like the tail drift correlates with prefill-heavy traffic in the synthetic — saw spikes when many small batches interleaved with big prefill requests. I captured an alloc flame: https://perf.internal/flames/8429-prefill.png

perf-bot: Automated bench summary for PR #8429: https://bench.internal/compare/8429 vs main — p95 regression 15% (small sample). Tags: canary, nightly-run. :robot_face:

Jordan: Quick repro command if anyone wants to run locally: 
```
./tools/run_microbench --model=redwood-4k --seq=4096 --batch=3 --iters=200 --prefill-mix=0.25
```
This reproduces the tail for me in ~5m.

Alice: I can run that against our infra overnight and post logs in the morning. If I don't see the mem drift at 12k iters, are we comfortable merging?

Maria: Ideally we want to be sure it's not a sustained leak. If Alice clears longer runs (12k+ iters) with similar mix, I'm fine merging today. Otherwise hold until we isolate.

Chris: One more data point: I reran with smaller batch horizon and the p95 drops back near baseline, so hypothesis is allocator reacquire under interleaved prefill.

Sam: If that's true, a small allocator guard (avoid reacquire on small prefill path) could fix quickly. Is that safe to patch pre-merge?

Jordan: If the guard is ~20–40 lines and covered by unit tests, I'm fine approving. We should also add a canary config to stress interleaved prefill in CI.

Maria: Sounds reasonable. @Chris @Jordan @Sam — can one of you give the +1 if you can review the tiny guard? Trying to avoid cascading canary failures today. :pray:

Chris: I'll take a look in the next hour. If it's small, I can approve.

Sam: Happy to review too. If Jordan is okay adding the CI canary, that reduces risk.

Jordan: Will add the CI job after merge if we land the guard with tests.

Alice: Ran the long repro overnight — attached log and memory graph: https://bench.internal/artifacts/8429-alice-log.txt — I still see the same +0.7–0.9GB at tail after ~10k iters. Repro steps and raw numbers in the artifact.

Maria: Thanks Alice — given that, let's block merge until guard is in. Moving PR to hold and labeling. I'll follow up with a brief PR comment summarizing these points.

perf-bot: Label update: pr/8429 -> hold/regression.

Chris: On it, opening a small fix PR now and will ping when ready.

Sam: Once Chris's fix lands, I'll rerun the canary against the same artifact set and report.

Maria: Appreciate it everyone. Short next steps: Chris will open the guard PR, Jordan will add CI job after merge, Sam will rerun canary, Alice will double-check long-run stability. Ping here when you have results. :thumbsup:
